why: An August 2025 arXiv paper by Dutour Sikirić and Van Woerden enumerates all perfect lattices in dimension 9 via Voronoi's algorithm and reports the exact value of the Hermite constant γ9 = 2, resolving the value for a dimension explicitly excluded by this bullet's '1-8 and 24' phrasing.
